evidenceTaxonomy.description: Added TargetEvidenceClass to types.ts as the required conceptual taxonomy, with RelationshipCandidate gaining an optional, backward-compatible evidenceClass field.

classes.STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE: Caption/operative target-naming, or an actual 'Section X ... is hereby amended' tie.
classes.SUPPORTING_TARGET_EVIDENCE: Title/date/party/type coincidence alone, or a WHEREAS recital with an explicit amend-tie.
classes.CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY: WHEREAS recital, cross-default, background, 'as defined in' - never alone sufficient for a RESOLVED modification edge.

p05Remediation.rootCause: resolvePackageRelationships called findAllAgreementReferences over the WHOLE preamble window of an amendment-shaped document and generated one independent RelationshipCandidate per matched dated-agreement-reference, resolving each purely by (type, execution date) coincidence - no mechanism distinguished 'the document this amendment actually targets' from 'an agreement merely mentioned in a WHEREAS recital.'
p05Remediation.fix: classifyReferenceEvidence(docText, ref, recitalBounds) is now the single choke point every matched reference passes through before it may reach RESOLVED for a modification-type relationship (AMENDS/RESTATES/SUPPLEMENTS/JOINS - instrument-grouping's own grouping set). Checks NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS first (clause-bounded window), determines whether the reference sits inside a WHEREAS-recital span (findRecitalBounds), classifies recital references as CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY unless tied to explicit amend-language, non-recital references default to STRONG unless a contextual-mention keyword is present with no operative tie.
p05Remediation.bugFoundAndFixedMidImplementation: A naive +/-300-char window let an EARLIER true-target reference in the caption accidentally absorb a LATER, unrelated recital's cross-default language. Fixed with clauseBoundsAround, a real clause-boundary detector requiring a capital-letter lookahead after a sentence-ending period (so corporate abbreviations like 'Corp.'/'Inc.' aren't mistaken for sentence breaks).
p05Remediation.mainLoopChange: A CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_ONLY/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE reference for a modification-type edge is now forced UNRESOLVED (confidence 0) BEFORE resolveAgreementReference ever runs - the type+date coincidence is never even consulted. A SUPPORTING_TARGET_EVIDENCE reference that would have resolved is downgraded from RESOLVED to REVIEW_REQUIRED.
p05Remediation.sameFilterAppliedToModificationCandidate: The same evidence filter was applied to the per-section ModificationCandidate resolution - previously ANY multiple reference count (including a purely contextual one) forced REVIEW_REQUIRED or could stand in as the sole 'resolved' reference. Contextual/negative references are now excluded before counting how many agreements a document references.

beforeAfterProof.before: False edge: unrelated-indenture, status=RESOLVED, confidence=0.95, merged into the base's instrument cluster.
beforeAfterProof.after: True edge: base, RESOLVED, confidence=0.95, evidenceClass=STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE. False edge: unrelated-indenture is UNRESOLVED, confidence=0, evidenceClass=NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE, resolutionMethod=DETERMINISTIC_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_EXCLUDED. Instrument cluster containing base: ['amend','base'] only, unrelated-indenture forms its own separate singleton instrument.

p05Remediation.singleQuoteVariantProof: Test 10b (removing the amendment's caption self-reference, so the Indenture reference would have been the ONLY resolvable reference, never triggering PKG-02's coincidental multi-target flag) confirms the false edge still never resolves - proving the fix is not merely relying on the multi-target coincidence.

list: genuine multi-target amendment (NEW test 17 - an Omnibus Amendment legitimately amending both a base Credit Agreement and a Guarantee-and-Collateral Agreement in its operative body: both edges resolve RESOLVED/STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE, proving the fix discriminates by evidence, not blanket multi-target caution)

p07Determination.reasoning: The coincidental REVIEW_REQUIRED flag in instrument-grouping.ts is now redundant for the false-edge class P0-5 covered - the root-cause fix prevents the false edge from ever reaching RESOLVED regardless of whether a second target creates ambiguity (proven by test 10b, which removes the multi-target trigger entirely and the false edge still never resolves). The flag was NOT removed (still serves a distinct, legitimate purpose - surfacing genuine base-ambiguity in a cluster for other reasons) - instead a new, explicit defense-in-depth layer, isTrustedGroupingEdge, was added to instrument-grouping.ts: even a RESOLVED grouping-type edge is only trusted to union two documents into one instrument when evidenceClass is undefined (pre-taxonomy backward compat) or STRONG_TARGET_EVIDENCE.
p07Determination.currentlyAlwaysTrueGivenP05Fix: In today's pipeline this defense-in-depth check is currently always satisfied given the P0-5 fix (SUPPORTING never reaches RESOLVED for modification-type edges) - it is a pure safety net against future regressions or a differently-computed RESOLVED row.

breakingShapeChangeNote: None. RelationshipCandidate gained one new OPTIONAL field (evidenceClass?); all pre-existing fields unchanged in name/type/semantics. ResolutionStatus remains the same 3-value union (RESOLVED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNRESOLVED) - no new status values. PackageGraphResult/InstrumentGroupingResult shapes unchanged. Confirmed non-breaking for Workstream E's consumption of this data.

testRunOutput.resultAtWorkstreamCompletion: 78 passed, 0 failed (broader tests/contract-model/ suite: 922 passed, 14 pre-existing DATABASE_URL failures unrelated to this workstream)

residualLimitations: Evidence-taxonomy gating applied only to modification-type relationships (AMENDS/RESTATES/SUPPLEMENTS/JOINS), matching instrument-grouping's own grouping set - GUARANTEES/SECURES/INTERCREDITOR_WITH/CERTIFIES_COMPLIANCE_WITH edges still use pre-existing type+date resolution unchanged (no counterexample found there by the original audit); evidenceClass is computed and attached for transparency but doesn't gate them.
clauseBoundsAround is regex-based, tuned to standard WHEREAS/NOW-THEREFORE drafting and common abbreviation patterns - an unusual clause-punctuation style could misjudge a boundary.
CONTEXTUAL_MENTION_PATTERNS/OPERATIVE_TIE_PATTERNS/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS are a curated, non-exhaustive keyword/phrase set.
